topic.readerProblem: Someone leaving or avoiding AthenaHQ wants to know why people look elsewhere and which alternatives fit a one-time check, cheaper daily tracking, SEO plus AI tracking, or enterprise scale, with prices that are current.
topic.connection: AEOeye is a one-time AI visibility audit and one of the options listed. The page places it honestly next to continuous trackers, says it does not replace them, and tells readers to take a snapshot before buying monitoring.

assessment: The page is documentation-based and says so near the top. The reasons to look elsewhere come only from AthenaHQ's own plans page (metered credits with unpublished add-on prices, scale features on a quote-only tier, a Free plan that is a sampler). Entry prices for Otterly.AI, Peec AI, LLMrefs, Nightwatch and Profound were read from their own pricing pages on 2026-10-03, with Peec and Nightwatch read from the rendered page in a browser because their prices are JavaScript-rendered. It adds a cost-per-answer yardstick with caveats and SparkToro's run-to-run variance research, and a neutral fact box from AEOeye's crawler study. It deliberately does not rank the vendors on quality, quote customer results, or claim hands-on use of any product; Otterly's trial length is omitted because its pricing page does not state it.

sources.supports: Starter $295/month, 3,600 credits, 1 credit = 1 AI response; extra credits and API access are paid add-ons with no published price; Starter single region and language; Enterprise card lists multi-region, persona targeting, Citation Engine, SAML SSO, BI dashboards on custom pricing; Free plan $25 credit / 300 credits / five platforms; Starter lists 11 models; integrations GA4, Search Console, Shopify, Webflow listed on the plan table.

Lite $29/month with 15 prompts, 4 engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, MS Copilot) with Claude, AI Mode and Gemini as extra add-ons, daily tracking; Standard $189 for 100 prompts; free trial offered (length not stated on the page).

Starter $95/month, 50 prompts, choose 3 models, unlimited users, daily tracking, 4,500 monthly AI answers (50 x 3 x 30, as the page defines it); Pro $245 with 150 prompts and 13,500 answers; read from the rendered page in a browser because prices are JavaScript-rendered.
Pricing section: All in One $79/month marked 'limited time only', 500 prompts, weekly reports, all AI engines at no extra fee, 7-day free trial; free account to set up a project (FAQ).

Starter €99/month billed monthly (read from the Monthly toggle in a browser) and €79 on yearly billing; 500 keywords, 50 AI prompts, 1,500 AI answers a month; platforms ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode, AI Overview; 14-day trial, no credit card.
Brand plans: free Trial (50 prompts run daily for 7 days; ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) and custom Enterprise (up to 9 answer engines, SSO/SAML).
Under 1-in-100 chance that ChatGPT or Google's AI returns the same brand list twice; advice to ask usually at least 60-100 times and average (published 27 Jan 2026).
